::: {.obsidian-lab-report}
:::

State the aim in one paragraph. Say what the experiment set out to
measure and why.

# Method

Describe the apparatus and procedure. Give enough detail for a
reader to repeat the work.

# Results

Present the measurements and the calculated values. Use a table for
the raw data and state the uncertainties.

# Analysis

Show the calculations. State the derived value with its uncertainty
and compare it with the accepted value.

# Conclusion

State what the experiment established. Name the main sources of
error and how to reduce them.
